title: Third-Party Administrator (TPA) and PMJAY Cashless Authorization Policy
rules: Pre-authorization claims must be electronically transmitted within statutory timeframes (24 hours for emergency, 48 hours prior for elective).
Patients with denied cashless claims must be given written notification within 60 minutes and converted to self-pay tariff.
No patient may be detained or denied emergency care due to pending or rejected insurance pre-authorizations.
Any bill revision exceeding 20% of pre-approved sanction requires immediate interim enhancement submission.
exceptions: PMJAY/CMCHIS emergency golden hour cases where pre-auth approval is deemed retrospective by state nodal agency.
